name: DS Cluster D09: GDP Revisions (known heavy revisions)
description: Tests economic_revisions with GDPC1 (Real GDP) which has significant quarterly revisions.
source:
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rev = economic_revisions(series_id="GDPC1")()
initial = ffill(rev.initial_value)
latest = ffill(rev.latest_value)
revision_delta = ffill(rev.revision_delta)
histogram(category="Revisions", title="GDP Initial", bins=20)(initial)
